title: Taylor Swift equals Frank Sinatra's Album of the Year record with her eighth nomination
summary: She has five nominations in all, including Record of the Year for "The Fate of Ophelia".
body:
Taylor Swift has been nominated for Album of the Year for the eighth time, for The Life of a Showgirl, equalling Frank Sinatra's record for the most nominations in the category by a lead artist.

She is already the only artist to have won Album of the Year four times.

Five nominations

Swift received five nominations in all, including Record of the Year for "The Fate of Ophelia", Song of the Year and Best Song Written for Visual Media.

Variety notes that she has now been nominated in the category for five studio albums in a row, a run matched only by Kendrick Lamar.

Sources: the Recording Academy, Variety, The Hollywood Reporter.
